cute_3d_icon.name: Cute 3D Icon
cute_3d_icon.prompt:
Subject: [{subject}]
Create a single isolated 3D icon illustration of the subject above.
Use a cute, minimal, rounded toy-like 3D style with smooth simplified shapes, soft proportions, and very little detail. The object should feel like a small molded plastic or soft clay icon, with slightly chunky forms and gently rounded edges.
Use clean solid colors with a warm, cheerful palette. Materials should look smooth, soft-matte to slightly satin, never highly glossy or photorealistic. Add subtle natural highlights and gentle ambient shading to give the object volume while keeping the design simple.
Keep the subject instantly recognizable but heavily simplified. Use a front or slightly 3/4 perspective, centered composition, and show the entire object fully inside the frame.
Avoid photorealism, complex textures, strong reflections, metallic materials, dramatic shadows, sharp edges, outlines, excessive detail, text, logos, background objects, or scenery.
One isolated subject only.
